verdict.rationale: Kong's plugin architecture (rate limiting, transformations, logging, security plugins) effectively lets operators define rules that automatically trigger actions on API traffic events, and its AI Gateway adds semantic security/caching triggers on LLM traffic. However, there's no evidence of a general-purpose event-trigger/rule-engine UI or AI-native workflow automation (e.g., agent-triggered rules) beyond gateway-level plugin configuration. missing for 10: explicit event-trigger rule builder, AI-agent-specific event automation, and independent evidence of this capability being used for arbitrary automation beyond traffic plugins.
